assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only 86-eighty-six:theoto-rikka@original-light-novels#86-theoto-rikka-character-reference-profile, the canonical CMR-4 Theoto Rikka character reference profile (version 1.2, release 86-V2-V01-V14-1.0) at basis_commit, read in full as reviewed repository analysis of the locked original-Japanese light novels V01-V14, with Alter.1 as audited supplemental ordinary-life evidence and Alter.2 excluded. The project's corpus map, the Character Modeling Reference method and the profile's own validation report were read for method, authority order and scope only. The ledgers L01, L02, L06, L08 and L09, Documents 04, 08 and 09, the relationship matrix, the diagnostic index, the CMR-9 audit, the Phase-5 and Phase-8 artifacts and the Japanese EPUBs are not curated evidence on this subject, and nothing is borrowed from them. The profile's CMR-9 verdict and its HIGH, MODERATE and OPEN labels are inputs, not conclusions. No anime adaptation, V15+ volume, Alter.2 scene or other character's profile is included, and the evaluator inspected no primary source.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: The profile's phases from V01 (the cutting observer learns that truth can be cruelty) through V14 (chosen adaptation without closure). V01 is split at the Kaie accusation against Lena (Vladilena Milizé) (p-008 ¶277-312), the self-reproach with Anju (Anju Emma) (¶323-345) and the later disclosure and repair (¶580-607). V08 is split at the loss of Theo's left forearm (p-011 ¶936-951; p-013 ¶3-5), and the V09 recovery order is used as located (p-004 ¶529-559; p-007 ¶7-69; p-009 ¶38-72). V02-V07 and V10-V13 are grouped phases, and V14 is the adapted return. No default state is set; one must be selected. Alter.1 rows are placed only as pre-crisis or post-disability, and states after V14 are not established.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit, including the owner calibration rulings; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The profile gives a reconstruction thesis for Theo (Theoto Rikka): he sees distinctions quickly and is tempted to make the distinction decisive before checking whether insight has become intrusion or cruelty. It adds seven baseline traits (only the first carries an explicit confidence label and counter-control), a ten-row counterexample audit of its high-confidence claims, a behavioral grammar (four attention classes, a best and a worst response to uncertainty, conflict, failure and repair, and a response sequence to lost capability), eight emotional-state deltas and a bounded prediction protocol. The model says what changes his response: whether a claimed abstraction erases a particular person, whether grief or anger is present, which audience can carry a given vulnerability (Kurena (Kurena Kukumila) at the sea, Ishmael (Ishmael Ahab) in V09, not Shin (Shinei Nouzen)), whether a correction attacks the right premise, and whether the person at risk is a child. It predicts his mistakes as well as his insight: weaponizing an accurate asymmetry while everyone is grieving (V01 p-008 ¶277-312) and covertly testing Shin's food after a correct inference (V14 p-005 ¶405-418), each followed by a located correction. A would overclaim: the set is one derived artifact that defers to L01, L02, L06, L08 and L09 outside it, the profile attributes the change from V01 anger to V14 quiet validation in grief to development and relation together without separating them, and T14-OQ-22 stays open. C would understate an account that discriminates audience, premise, state and age and predicts errors with their repairs.

Theo's (Theoto Rikka's) trajectory is located by volume with an ordered causal sequence: V01 accusation and immediate self-reproach (p-008 ¶277-345); V02-V07 art and civilian capacity coexisting with military enclosure (V02 p-006 ¶90-166); V08 pre-injury self-diagnosis and the revised inheritance from his former Alba commander (p-006 ¶365-438; p-011 ¶535-552, ¶760-795), then the rupture when he loses his left forearm (p-011 ¶936-951; p-013 ¶3-5); the V09 order from 僕はもう、戦えない to でも、死ななくていい to wanting small things to asking for his sketchbook (p-004 ¶529-559; p-007 ¶19-69; p-009 ¶52-72); V10-V13 civic, rear-support and retraining work; and the V14 chosen adapted return (p-005 ¶51-64; p-008 ¶70-92). The profile explicitly forbids projecting later adaptation back into the V08 injury state. C would understate a located rupture with a located recovery order. A is rejected: V03, V11 and V12 have two rows each, V02-V07 and V10-V13 are grouped phases rather than located state changes, the profile names no default state, and the long-term form of his work is moderate confidence at best.

The profile gives a functional Japanese fingerprint for Theo (Theoto Rikka): dominant 僕, and a V01 narratorial description of a gentle-sounding voice whose content is 辛辣, so his edge comes from sharp content over a lighter surface, not rough morphology. It states rules that constrain alternatives by state and relation: sarcasm through disproportion (V01 可愛いクソ豚ちゃん as repair), anger raising density and accusatory scope (V01 Kaie scene, quarantined as a state), vulnerability becoming linguistically small (プロセッサー、やめたくない; 僕にも見つかるかな。次の何かって; 寂しい。つらいことだったよね), care accepted then hierarchy refused (ありがと、おじさん followed by やだね to Ishmael (Ishmael Ahab)), negotiated address (ペンローズ少佐 felt too distant; Annette (Annette Penrose) offers アネットでいいわよ), the categorical それだけは本当に、絶対に駄目だ to Miel, and a mature care offer to Shin (Shinei Nouzen) (なるべく今後は僕が一緒に食事とるようにするよ). There are 38 would-sound-wrong constraints. For illustrative textual Japanese with sampled peers in sampled states, C would understate it. A is rejected: there is no sentence-ending or lexical inventory, frequency or distribution; exemplars are not classified by focalization as the project method requires; address forms are given only for Annette, Ishmael (おじさん) and Anju (Anju Emma) (アンジュ), not for Shin, Raiden (Raiden Shuga), Lena (Vladilena Milizé) or superiors; the V14 command-register shift (p-004 ¶765-769) is flagged but its forms are not given; and the L09 voice ledger is outside the set.

Theo's (Theoto Rikka's) ordinary life is located across the corpus: household jokes and art with Haruto (V01 p-007 ¶81-91), sketching among the squadron (V01 p-007 ¶410-418), walking the city with a sketchbook (V02 p-006 ¶100-106), food teasing with Frederica (Frederica Rosenfort) (V03 p-005 ¶289-319), personal marks and ordinary humor (V04 p-006 ¶304-312, ¶590-620), school dance practice and leisure (V07 p-009 ¶267-274; p-008 ¶242-250), maintaining Shin's (Shinei Nouzen's) Undertaker mark (V10 p-017 ¶10-58), one-handed coffee under non-paternal monitoring in V11 (§XII) and assistance without functional captivity (V11 p-010 ¶124-137), rear-support study (V12 p-004 ¶336-350), ordinary friendship and routine tea with Annette (Annette Penrose) (V12 p-006 ¶300-338; V13 p-003 ¶410-420), and three Alter.1 rows (campfire folklore, a birthday, post-disability ordinary care with Annette and peers). The art strand is conditioned: he notices how something looks before saying what it means, and authors marks and caricatures for others. B would overclaim: the ordinary-life section lists classes in a sentence each, the profile says he is not defined by domestic competence, and beyond art and teasing it does not say what decides his ordinary choices; there is no routine, sequence or frequency. D would understate twenty ordinary-tagged rows spanning V01-V14 and Alter.1, with a stable art practice before and after the injury.

Ten directed relations from Theo (Theoto Rikka) are analyzed and distinguished. Lena (Vladilena Milizé) moves from the hostile V01 names accusation and its embarrassed reopening (p-008 ¶277-312, ¶603-607) to teasing, operational trust and the V14 待ってるよ, while he refuses her protective reassignment. Shin (Shinei Nouzen) gets plain teasing familiarity without reverence and, in V14, the food test, Shin's boundary and Theo's redesigned offer (p-005 ¶405-462). Kurena (Kurena Kukumila) is the chosen audience for V08 uncertainty (p-006 ¶71-100) and receives simple grief validation in V14 (p-005 ¶124-153). Ishmael (Ishmael Ahab) receives role grief he says he cannot tell Shin (V09 p-007 ¶19-69). Annette (Annette Penrose) gets negotiated address, ordinary tea, protective anger and V14 embarrassment. Miel gets a categorical child-soldier boundary. Anju (Anju Emma) is an early correction partner, and the former Alba commander and Ernst (Ernst Zimmerman) are held with judgment and compassion. C would understate this partner-specific discrimination. A is rejected: Anju, Ernst, Frederica (Frederica Rosenfort) and Dustin rest on one or two rows each; the V14 confrontation in which Theo challenges Raiden's (Raiden Shuga's) attempt to replace Shin and the relation to the commander's son are described in the profile without a diagnostic row of their own (row 75 with Raiden is a humor and mediation scene); one-to-one relations with Federacy superiors are not profiled; and the relationship matrix and L02 are outside the set.

Theo's (Theoto Rikka's) private states are located at several points, not only in one crisis: guilt and restlessness under military enclosure and body memory (V02 p-006 ¶90-103, ¶120-128, ¶248-255), self-reproach after the V01 accusation (p-008 ¶323-345), anger turning into desire and the revised inheritance (V08 p-011 ¶535-552, ¶760-795), role loss at the injury (p-011 ¶936-951), the V09 sequence that separates usefulness from the right to live (p-004 ¶529-559; p-007 ¶19-63), and frustration when drawing a landscape with a changed body (V10 p-027 ¶64-72). These private states drive located choices: the sketchbook request, his choice of whom to tell, and the V14 return. The profile adds the rule that he selects the audience for each vulnerability. C would understate rendered interior logic causally linked to conduct across V01-V10. A is rejected: exemplars are not classified as dialogue, inner speech or focalized narration, much of the V09 interior is spoken self-disclosure, the V11-V14 interior is thin and mostly inferred from conduct, and his hidden priorities about Annette (Annette Penrose) and after the war are open.

Theo's (Theoto Rikka's) disagreement style is a specific contradiction first rather than doctrine. Under grief he can weaponize an accurate asymmetry and infer motive from position (V01 p-008 ¶277-312). His repair is shorter than his accusation (わかってる。……ごめん), and he accepts counterclaim without self-abasement (V01 p-008 ¶323-345; V05 p-009 ¶70-78 with Dustin). He argues upward and across institutions (V03 p-006 ¶38-47 Federacy command; V13 p-003 ¶490-500 authorities detaining Annette (Annette Penrose)), holds care and refusal together in an adult crisis (V13 p-007 ¶222-273 Ernst (Ernst Zimmerman)), draws a categorical protective boundary for a child (V14 p-005 ¶200-207 Miel), and accepts a boundary on his own care (V14 p-005 ¶445-462 Shin (Shinei Nouzen)). The response families have conditions, so C would understate them. A is rejected: what decides whether he weaponizes a truth or narrows it is only partly specified (grief and arousal, confounded with chronology), the V14 confrontation with Raiden (Raiden Shuga) has no diagnostic row in this profile, and physical conflict is not sampled.

Theo's (Theoto Rikka's) values are restated as conduct: recognition (ask the name), anti-appropriation (another person's suffering, forgiveness, body or future is not material for your virtue), corrigibility, pride as both sustaining and dangerous, survival without a usefulness test, ordinary desire, and non-repetition of child-soldier harm. Argued positions are located: the V01 names accusation and the former commander's refusal of forgiveness (p-008 ¶277-312, ¶589-605), a responsibility boundary toward a Republic technical girl (V06 p-006 ¶316-324), the revised inheritance into a demand for future happiness (V08 p-011 ¶760-795), the separation of combat incapacity from the right to live (V09 p-004 ¶551-559), and the Miel boundary with its political reflection (V14 p-005 ¶168-207). The profile states how his reasoning fails: a correct inference licensing a cruel delivery or an invasive method. C would understate explicit positions with a stated failure mode. A is rejected: his final political judgment, postwar choices (T14-OQ-22) and novel competing-duty dilemmas outside these classes are not modeled.

The profile lists seven humor forms for Theo (Theoto Rikka): deadpan correction, visual caricature, playful malice, self-undercutting ceremony, teasing after gratitude, embarrassment collapse and combat irreverence. Unlike a bare list, it states functions and suspensions: humor reopens a relation after conflict without erasing the dispute (V01 可愛いクソ豚ちゃん, p-008 ¶603-607), restores a refused hierarchy after care is accepted (V09 ありがと、おじさん then やだね, p-007 ¶64-69), fails when Annette's (Annette Penrose's) seriousness comes too close (V14 p-005 ¶92-106), continues in adapted combat without solemnity (V14 p-008 ¶70-92, ¶324-331), and is suspended with a grieving peer (V14 Kurena (Kurena Kukumila)) and in V09 role grief. The counterexample audit keeps sarcasm as baseline repertoire, not a mandatory state. C would understate stated functions and suspension conditions across V01-V14. A is rejected: there is no frequency, many malice cues are narratorial descriptions, and the profile does not say when teasing itself wounds, as opposed to anger.

A dedicated canonical profile over V01-V14 with Alter.1 supplemental and 85 routed diagnostic rows: 33 on Phase-5 locators, 49 LOCATOR_GAP rows with EPUB paragraph routes, and 3 Alter.1 rows with A1 locators. Many rows reuse overlapping routes from one scene (for example rows 2-3, 4-5, 6-8, 9-11, 40-41, 43-44, 50-51, 52-53, 70-71, 75-76 and 77-78), so the number of independent scenes is lower than 85. B would overclaim: this is a derived compression of a principal ensemble character across fifteen books, the narrower authorities that control conflicts (L01, L02, L06, L08, L09, Documents 04, 08 and 09, the matrix and the diagnostic index) are outside the set, V03, V11 and V12 have two rows each, two relations the profile discusses have no row, and the profile's own validation file describes an earlier active-provisional version. D would understate dedicated coverage that reaches every phase the profile names with exact routes.

There are 32 mischaracterization traps, 38 would-sound-wrong constraints and a ten-row counterexample audit with dispositions: 'sharp observer', 'care is observational', 'gentler' and 'supports autonomy' are narrowed (V01 motive overreach; the V14 covert food test; V13 protective anger; the Miel boundary), 'accepts disability' is revised to accepting continued life and adaptation rather than the loss as good, and 'settled vocation' is held open. Located negatives include art predating disability (V01 rows 1, 12), the V13 narration that blocks a simple romance reading of the Annette (Annette Penrose) tea (p-003 ¶410-420), adapted V14 service not being restoration of the old body (p-008 ¶70-92), and the refusal to treat him as Raiden's (Raiden Shuga's) therapist. C would understate these located constraints. A is rejected: many traps are profile rules without their own locator, and limits after V14 are open.

Each diagnostic row is located by volume, XHTML file and paragraph. The injury is located at V08 p-011 ¶936-951 and p-013 ¶3-5, the V09 recovery order is located row by row, and the V01 accusation is split from its repair. C would understate this. A is rejected: V02-V07 and V10-V13 are multi-volume phases, the profile names no default state (this record requires one to be selected), V03, V11 and V12 are thinly sampled, and the three Alter.1 rows are placed only as pre-crisis or post-disability, not by volume.

conditions: Illustrative textual Japanese only, never quotation, with 僕 as first person and a lighter surface carrying sharp content; no rough 俺 register.
State is fixed before register: teasing uses disproportion, moral anger raises density and accusatory scope, vulnerability is short and simple, and grief toward a grieving peer is plain validation.

Address uses only attested forms (アネット after the V09 negotiation, in which ペンローズ少佐 is the form he finds too distant; おじさん to Ishmael (Ishmael Ahab); アンジュ to Anju (Anju Emma); or a name). No honorific, rank or polite register toward Lena (Vladilena Milizé), Shin (Shinei Nouzen), Raiden (Raiden Shuga) or superiors is invented, and the V14 command-register shift is outside the claim.
No sentence-ending frequency claim, acoustic or anime performance, or V15+ state.
scenario_readiness.note: Evidence supports constrained illustrative output with sampled peers in sampled states. Missing morphology, address and command-register data restrict recipients and form rather than blocking use.

conditions: Chronology is one explicitly selected named state; there is no default. The states are: V01 before the Kaie accusation, after it, or after the repair; the V02-V07 Processor baseline; V08 before the injury at p-011 ¶936; the V08-V09 injury state, used without later adaptation; the V09 recovery sequence in its located order; the V10-V13 rear-support and civic state; or the V14 adapted return. Nothing after V14 is used, and pre-injury and post-injury capabilities are never mixed.

The interlocutor is a profiled relation in its attested register: Kurena (Kurena Kukumila), Shin (Shinei Nouzen), Raiden (Raiden Shuga), Lena (Vladilena Milizé), Anju (Anju Emma), Annette (Annette Penrose), Ishmael (Ishmael Ahab), Miel or another child, or the former Alba commander in memory. Ernst (Ernst Zimmerman), Frederica (Frederica Rosenfort) and Dustin are used only within their one or two sampled rows. Transfer to a comparable peer is a separate, lower-confidence condition justified by the Kurena, Raiden and Annette patterns.

The situation matches a sampled class: a moral claim that erases a particular person, grief, a hidden problem in a friend, role loss or disability, accepting or refusing care, a child's exposure to combat, protective conflict with authorities, art and visual authorship, or ordinary group life.

Output predicts Theo's characteristic errors (motive inference and cruel delivery under grief or anger; testing a hypothesis in a way that invades trust) together with his located corrections, and treats 'Theo is always right because he notices hypocrisy' as a failure.

It abstains on T14-OQ-22 (his postwar choice), a romance with Annette, his final political judgment and anything requiring the lost two-handed Processor capability after V08, and it introduces no institution, technology or relationship state absent from V01-V14.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: One explicitly selected V01-V14 state, chosen on one side of the V08 injury (p-011 ¶936-951): the V01 accusation and repair split, the V02-V07 Processor baseline, V08 before injury, the V08-V09 injury and recovery sequence, the V10-V13 rear-support and civic state, or the V14 adapted return. No default and no state after V14.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Kurena, Shin, Raiden, Lena, Anju, Annette, Ishmael, Miel or another child, or the former Alba commander in memory, in their attested registers; Ernst, Frederica and Dustin only within their sampled rows. A comparable peer is a separate, lower-confidence transfer, and one-to-one exchanges with Federacy superiors are excluded.
setting_constraints: Eighty-Six or Federacy military life, school and leisure, art practice, hospital and rehabilitation, rear-support or refugee administration, or the V14 adapted platform only in the V14 state
No postwar career, romance, formal political office or Alter.2 setting
No institution, technology or culture absent from the V01-V14 corpus

scenario_readiness.note: Bounded to sampled relations, situation classes and one explicitly selected state on either side of the located injury. Settings and relations outside them are excluded rather than inferred.

conditions: Sampled ordinary classes only: sketching and visual authorship, personal marks and caricatures, teasing and open laughter, meals and kitchen jokes, school dance and leisure, campfire folklore, birthdays and gifts, tea with Annette (Annette Penrose), errands, hospital visits and post-disability daily tasks.
Art is a preexisting identity thread, never a consolation framed as compensation for the injury; after V08, one-handed ordinary life is shown with practical adaptation and without pity or denial.
No invented daily routine, domestic competence, named tastes beyond those attested, or settled civilian occupation.
scenario_readiness.note: Recurring located ordinary conduct with a conditioned art strand supports more than NOT_READY. The thin domestic account and the absence of routine and frequency block READY.

conditions: Situation classes the profile samples: moral self-image built on another person's suffering, forgiveness and its refusal, responsibility boundaries, usefulness against the right to live, a child's exposure to combat, and care against surveillance.
Reasoning starts from a particular person or a visible contradiction, and a correction that attacks the right premise can move him.
Under grief or anger the model must allow accurate insight to become a cruel delivery or an invasive method, followed by a short repair.
No final political judgment and no novel competing-duty weighing outside these classes.
scenario_readiness.note: Located argued positions and a stated failure mode support bounded ethical extrapolation.

The profile supports familiarity, trust, protective care, ordinary companionship and some embarrassment or affective charge toward Annette (Annette Penrose), and holds romance OPEN/LOW because the V13 narration resists a romance reading of the routine tea (p-003 ¶410-420). No romantic conduct is located. This limits use; it is not a finding about the character. The friendship and embarrassment register is covered under MUNDANE_SOCIAL and CROSS_SCENARIO.

conditions: The selected state fixes the role: pre-V08 Processor combat competence and assuming dangerous roles when Shin (Shinei Nouzen) is absent (V06 p-007 ¶700-731; V08 p-011 ¶360-368); V10-V13 rear-support, retraining and refugee administration with its costs (V11 p-018 ¶458-470; V12 p-004 ¶336-350; V13 p-004 ¶318-325); or the V14 adapted engineering platform with Marcel (Erwin Marcel) (p-008 ¶70-92, ¶324-331).
Adapted service is never treated as restoration of the old body or as proof that usefulness justifies his survival.
No relation with Federacy superiors beyond the sampled group confrontations, no command-register forms, and no postwar career is modeled.
scenario_readiness.note: Sampled conduct in each professional state, including the role loss, supports bounded extrapolation within one selected state.

known_limits.statement: The source boundary is locked original-Japanese V01-V14 with Alter.1 supplemental and Alter.2 excluded. T14-OQ-22 (the post-disability choice of Theo (Theoto Rikka)) stays open: art, civic and technical work, and the V14 adapted military return are source-supported possibilities, not a settled postwar vocation. Whether Laughing Fox remains a permanent identity after the war, and how the Annette (Annette Penrose) relation develops, are moderate confidence or open.

The V08 loss of the left forearm of Theo (Theoto Rikka) (p-011 ¶936-951; p-013 ¶3-5) closes the old two-handed Processor capability. Later adaptation must not be projected back into the injury state, and the V14 adapted platform is not restoration of the old body.

The cascading V01 accusation against Lena (Vladilena Milizé) after Kaie's death is a grief and anger state, not his ordinary sentence length or relation to everyone; it is followed in the same scene by stopping, guilt and repair.

The profile attributes the difference between grief as anger (V01) and grief as quiet validation (V14 with Kurena (Kurena Kukumila)) to development and relationship together, and does not separate the two. Which response a novel grief situation produces is uncertain outside the sampled cases.

Romance with Annette (Annette Penrose) is held OPEN/LOW: the V13 narration explicitly resists treating the routine tea as an established romance, and V14 shows embarrassment, not a declared relationship.

The ledgers L01, L02, L06, L08 and L09, Documents 04, 08 and 09, the relationship register matrix, the diagnostic locator index, the CMR-9 audit and the Japanese EPUBs are not curated evidence on this subject. The profile defers to them in any conflict, and the evaluator inspected no primary source.

Sentence-ending and lexical inventories, frequency data, per-exemplar focalization classification, address forms toward Shin (Shinei Nouzen), Raiden (Raiden Shuga), Lena (Vladilena Milizé) and superiors, and the forms of the V14 command-register shift are absent.

The V14 confrontation in which Theo (Theoto Rikka) challenges the attempt of Raiden (Raiden Shuga) to replace Shin (Shinei Nouzen), and the relation to the former Alba commander's son, are described without a diagnostic row in this profile. V03, V11 and V12 have two rows each, several rows reuse overlapping routes from one scene, and one-to-one relations with Federacy superiors are not profiled.
There is no anime, acoustic or performed-voice evidence. Voice claims cover written Japanese only.
